basis: Epiphyseal dysplasia directly affects bones and joints, with limb deformity and early degenerative joint disease.
Congenital diaphragm defect; associated pulmonary hypoplasia directly impairs lung development in well over 30%.
Paragangliomas arise in neuroendocrine paraganglia of the autonomic nervous system; hypertension frequency is unspecified.
Amyloid deposition is localized to dermis and subcutis; associated autoimmune conditions are separate diseases.
Defined organ-specific forms include bronchiectasis and pancreatitis; neither implies multisystem CF. The CBAVD form is reproductive and has no axis.
Diabetic ketone accumulation and metabolic acidosis define the disease; other organ injuries are not sufficiently common defining features.
Benign smooth muscle tumour of the vulva, a reproductive site; smooth muscle origin does not establish locomotor involvement.
Thoracic aortic aneurysm and dissection define the disease; reported skeletal and pulmonary abnormalities are below 30%.
Inherited cardiac electrical disorder causing catecholamine-triggered polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.
Inherited retinal dysfunction causes congenital stationary night blindness; both supplied retinal features occur in 6/6 patients.
Testicular reproductive tumour; hormonal manifestations occur in approximately 25% and metastases in approximately 20%, below the involvement threshold.
Isolated inherited scalp hair deficiency, documented in 14/14 patients.
Superantigen-mediated shock; AKI and thrombocytopenia each occur in >30%. Hepatic dysfunction omitted by cap; rash and GI symptoms are transient.
Postsynaptic neuromuscular junction dysfunction defines the disorder; ocular and respiratory weakness do not establish direct eye or lung damage.
Carcinoma originates in the soft palate, part of the mouth; its oropharyngeal classification does not establish separate airway involvement.
Polyp directly occupies the sphenoidal sinus; paranasal sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis.
Malignant neoplasm of the intestine; metastatic organ involvement is not established across this umbrella concept.
Central/autonomic dysfunction causes fatal apnea; testicular dysgenesis impairs androgen development. Secondary cardiorespiratory arrest does not establish direct heart or lung damage.
Complete gonadal dysgenesis causes hypergonadotropic hypogonadism and absent secondary sex characteristics; no evidence supports the cardiomyopathy ancestor.
Selective primary antibody deficiency; respiratory and autoimmune diseases are predispositions, not established direct organ damage.
Acute sarcoid syndrome defined by erythema nodosum and ankle arthritis/periarthritis with hilar lymphadenopathy; hilar nodes alone do not establish lung damage.
Osteoid-producing sarcoma usually arises in deep locomotor soft tissues; rare visceral subtypes do not justify additional umbrella labels.
Mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction directly causes both nervous system and skeletal muscle disease; additional organ involvement varies by subtype.
Papilloma originates in respiratory mucosa lining the paranasal sinuses; bone and nervous system ancestors do not establish those tissue origins.
Supplied phenotype establishes abnormal lysosomal metabolism; no specific organ injury or frequency is provided to support additional axes.
